title: BPSC TRE 4.0 Recruitment 2026 Online Form Live: Apply for 45198 Teacher Posts #BPSCTRE4 #BiharTeacherBharti #BPSC_TRE_4.0 #BiharSarkariNaukri
intro: Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has Released Official Notification Online Application form for the Post of TRE 4.0 School Teacher Class 1 to 5, Class 6 to 8, Class 9 to 10, Class 11 to 12 and Special School Teacher for Class 9 to 10 under Education Department, Govt. of Bihar  & Class 1 to 5, Class 6 to 10 and Class 11 to 12 under SC & ST Welfare Dept., Govt of Bihar Recruitment 2026 for 45198 Post. Online Application Start on July, 2026 & Last Date is August, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Read Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in the Given Link Below.
